Name: Wind Strike
Description: With a blast of air, you leap up to 30 feet before making one unarmed strike or melee attack with a weapon you are holding. You can make two attacks if you have the Extra Attack class feature. On a hit, a target takes additional thunder damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the distance you can leap increases by 15 feet and the attacks deal an additional 1d8 thunder damage on a hit for each slot level above 2nd.
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
